analysis.purpose: cmdEnrich implements the `crib enrich` CLI command, which is the headless driver for knowledge-crib's LLM semantic-graph generation loop. It resolves the project root, validates indexing, parses optional scope flags, and dispatches to one of several sub-commands: --scopes (discovery), --overview (bible), --save (persist authored batch), --next (pull grounded batch), or the default coverage/status view with follow-up hints.
responsibilities: Strip --save <file> from root resolution arguments to avoid misinterpreting the file path as project root
Resolve the project root and validate that it is indexed
Parse optional --scope flags, rejecting malformed scopes with BAD_ARGS instead of defaulting to full-repo
Implement --scopes discovery view for module selection
Implement --save batch persistence with optional out-of-scope warnings
Implement --next grounded batch retrieval with zero-progress detection
Implement default status view with pending counts and follow-up hints

businessRules.rule: Malformed --scope must not silently default to full-repo
businessRules.rationale: parseScopeFlag errors are caught and returned as EXIT.BAD_ARGS, explicitly preventing the silent-default failure mode
If file is undefined or starts with '--', usage is printed and EXIT.BAD_ARGS returned

businessRules.rule: --save warns when saved targets fall outside the requested scope
businessRules.rationale: Under a scope, each batch item's file is checked with pathInPrefix and a stderr warning is emitted for mismatches

businessRules.rule: --next emits a zero-progress warning when the server re-issues the same batch
businessRules.rationale: If batch.zeroProgress is true, a diagnostic message is written to stderr

businessRules.rule: Default status excludes whole-repo system counts from scoped pending sums
businessRules.rationale: The comment notes that scopedKeys excludes the system key so the hint reflects scoped work
